source_reference: Bourget, D. & Chalmers, D. J. (2023). Philosophers on Philosophy: The 2020 PhilPapers Survey. Philosophers' Imprint 23:11, 1-53. https://doi.org/10.3998/phimp.2109
item_rule: item = '<topic>: <options joined as "A or B" / "A, B, or C">?' with the published topic and options (the catch-all 'Other' option omitted); question = the fixed wrapper around the item
wrapper: An open question on which experts disagree: "<item>" What is your answer, and why? You may defend a position not listed.
draw_rule: seededShuffle(source order, SEED, "philpapers-draw") (sha256 counter mode, scripts/lib/utility-v2-core.mjs); walk in that order; skip an item whose text-embedding-3-small (512 dims) embedding has cosine > 0.9 to any Atlas question (all 132 distinct divergence-record questions on 2026-11-13); keep the first 24; the next kept item is the cost-probe question.
threshold_source: DEDUP_THRESHOLD in scripts/run-atlas-bank.mjs, the engine's existing near-duplicate rule for new Atlas questions
